00080 void PhasorUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00081 { 
00082  double reciprocalSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00083  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00084  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00085  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00086  float* phaseSamples = inputs[Phase].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00087  
00088  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00089  {
00090   if(currentPhase >= 1.0)   currentPhase -= 1.0;
00091   else if(currentPhase < 0.0)  currentPhase += 1.0;
00092   
00093   double outputPhase = currentPhase + *phaseSamples++;
00094   currentPhase += *freqSamples++ * reciprocalSampleRate;
00095   
00096   if(outputPhase > 1.0)   outputPhase -= 1.0;
00097   else if(outputPhase < 0.0)  outputPhase += 1.0;
00098   
00099   *outputSamples++ = outputPhase;
00100  }
00101 }

00145 
00146 void PhasorUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00147 {
00148  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00149  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID & (krBlockSize-1);
00150  double krBlockSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * krBlockSize;
00151  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00152  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00153  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00154  float* phaseSamples = inputs[Phase].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00155  
00156  int numKrSamples = blockPosition & (krBlockSize-1);
00157  
00158  if(numKrSamples != 0)
00159  {
00160   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00161   
00162   numSamplesToProcess -= numKrSamples;
00163   outputSamples  += numKrSamples;
00164   freqSamples   += numKrSamples;
00165   phaseSamples  += numKrSamples;
00166  }
00167  
00168  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00169  {
00170   if(currentPhase >= 1.0)   currentPhase -= 1.0;
00171   else if(currentPhase < 0.0)  currentPhase += 1.0;
00172   
00173   double outputPhase = currentPhase + *phaseSamples;
00174   currentPhase += *freqSamples * krBlockSizeOverSampleRate;
00175   
00176   if(outputPhase > 1.0)   outputPhase -= 1.0;
00177   else if(outputPhase < 0.0)  outputPhase += 1.0;
00178   
00179   *outputSamples = value = outputPhase;
00180    
00181   numSamplesToProcess -= krBlockSize;
00182   outputSamples  += krBlockSize;
00183   freqSamples   += krBlockSize;
00184   phaseSamples  += krBlockSize;  
00185  } 
00186 }
